author: Unknown hand
pages: it doesn't END. every shelf has a shelf behind it. every book has a book inside it. the pages turn when I'm not looking and they are always on the page I need. that is the worst part.

I found my own name in a book. it was spelled correctly. it listed everything I have ever forgotten.

the Seekers drift between the stacks and they WATCH. the big ones, the Lurkers, wade through the ink like it's a shallow stream.

there is a book at the end of every chapter. read it to go on. read the other one to go HOME. I have read the wrong one four times.
if you are reading this, I got out. or I didn't, and this is a book now. either way: do not bargain with the eyes in the sky.
